summary: Generic artifact-review GATE store (cinatra#1796, epic #1620 S13) — the operator-upgrade twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts (artifactReviewGateSchemaQueries, the pure-strings leaf src/lib/artifacts/artifact-review-gate-schema.ts, spread in the SAME PR). Four brand-new tables backing the persistence half of the #1795/#1807 generic artifact-review surface: #1807 shipped the PURE cores (immutable review-target contract, preparation core, and the DECISION core with its one-transaction commit contract) and deliberately deferred BOTH the gate-EMISSION side that PINS the targets and the LIVE decision-submit binder to THIS slice, which owns the emitting gate. artifact_review_gates: ONE row per (run_id, review_task_id) (UNIQUE) — the emitting gate PINS the frozen {artifactId, representationRevisionId} target set at gate creation (status 'pending'), and a terminal decision CAS-resolves it (status 'resolved' + the idempotency fingerprint + disposition); it is the pending-gate anchor the preparation + decision cores read + CAS against. artifact_review_audit: one row per reviewed revision per decision, carrying the reviewed revision + the HOST-DERIVED renderer provenance (kind/package/digest, re-resolved from the artifact type at submit, never a client claim); UNIQUE (gate_id, decision_fingerprint, artifact_id, representation_revision_id) makes the audit insert idempotent under a response-lost retry. artifact_review_dispositions: the durable reject->TOMBSTONE disposition record (kind admits ONLY 'tombstone'; a review can never hard-delete); applied_at NULL means pending downstream tombstone application on the separate objects store (the tombstone cannot ride this store's transaction). artifact_review_resume_outbox: the terminal RESUME intent persisted EXACTLY ONCE (PK gate_id means at most one resume per resolved gate — no resolved-but-unresumed stranding and no double-persist), kind-discriminated ('approve'|'reject') so a reject can never drain down the approve wire, with a lease (lease_token + lease_expires_at, attempts) serializing the delivery worker's drain; DELIVERY is AT-LEAST-ONCE (a send-then-crash redelivers on lease expiry), so the downstream resume consumer must be idempotent per gate (the 0071 outbox-lease precedent). NO foreign keys to agent_runs ON PURPOSE (the auditor-review-companion / publication-operation precedent): the gate is keyed by run id (validated at WRITE time by the emitting gate's run-access guard, not FK-pinned) and must outlive run-row churn; the three child tables FK to artifact_review_gates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (meaningless without their gate), so this migration is self-contained (no cross-migration ordering). ADDITIVE (four brand-new empty tables + indexes) — the DDL MIRRORS the idempotent bootstrap leaf exactly (CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS): a no-op on a bootstrap-seeded schema, ledger-faked on a fresh install, executed by db migrate on an existing deployment; unqualified names resolve to the app schema on the runner's search_path. down() drops the child tables then the parent (reversible; carries no data on a fresh install; an interrupted review is re-emittable). SEQ 0072 — strictly greater than the max shipped seq on origin/main (core__0071 unbound-output-derivation-outbox); a concurrent lane may land the next seq first, in which case a rename-only renumber is normal (FLAGGED for the coordinator's train — W5's in-rework branch renumbers around this). migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
